hero.pill: Intelligent Automation • 100% GST Ready & Fully Unlocked
hero.subtitle: From smart GST e-invoicing to automated bank reconciliation and live inventory valuation. Experience accounting software engineered for precision, speed, and real-time business insights.

features.title: Every Financial Tool You Need
features.description: Everything a growing Indian business needs to run its finances, in one place.

items.title: Smart GST Invoicing
items.text: Quotes, sales orders, invoices and credit notes with CGST/SGST/IGST, TCS, e-invoice and e-way bill JSON, GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B.

items.title: Get Paid Faster
items.text: UPI pay-by-QR on every invoice, a customer portal, AI-written payment reminders and invoices on WhatsApp.

items.title: Bank Reconciliation
items.text: Import any bank's CSV statement: lines auto-match to your books, become payments, or are booked to an account in one click.

items.title: AI Assistant
items.text: Scan a bill photo into a draft, ask questions about your books, and get account suggestions for bank lines.

items.title: Insights & Alerts
items.text: Duplicate-bill and unusual-amount alerts, customer credit-risk scores and a daily digest email.

items.title: Cash Planning
items.text: Cash-flow statement, a 13-week cash forecast and a what-if planner for late payments, new costs and big purchases.

items.title: Branches & Projects
items.text: Profit and loss by branch, project profitability with labour cost, mileage claims and budgets vs actual.

items.title: Inventory Control
items.text: Warehouses, transfers, batches with expiry, serial numbers, composite items, price lists and a stock ledger.

items.title: Multi-Currency & Assets
items.text: Invoices and bills in any currency with exchange gain/loss, plus a fixed asset register with depreciation.

items.title: Automation
items.text: Workflow rules, approvals, custom fields, recurring invoices and bills, and scheduled report emails.

items.title: Payroll & Time
items.text: Salary runs and payslips, timesheets, and invoices generated from billable hours.

items.title: Works with Tally
items.text: Export your books to Tally for your CA, or import Tally ledgers to get started in minutes.

items.name: Rajesh Kumar
items.quote: Rooman Books is blisteringly fast compared to traditional ERPs. Our inventory updates in milliseconds and GST returns take minutes instead of days.

items.name: Ananya Mehta
items.quote: Having all modules completely unlocked with authentic double-entry journals and bank reconciliation gave our accounting team a seamless experience.

items.question: How does Rooman Books ensure real-time speed and accuracy?
items.answer: Rooman Books uses an asynchronous financial engine with in-memory caching and real-time ledger synchronization.

items.question: Are all modules in the sidebar fully unlocked?
items.answer: Yes! All locks have been removed. Every module is 100% active and functional.

items.question: How does user access and authentication work?
items.answer: Click "Access Rooman Books" to go directly to the sign-in page. Sign in with your credentials or create a new organization account.

items.question: How is my financial data protected?
items.answer: Your financial transactions are encrypted with 256-bit bank-grade security and backed up continuously.
